items.title: Louis Cottrell, Jr. Interview, 1961-08-25
items.q: Tats always remarked now that he knew just what it was after Lorenzo had gotten paralyzed

ctx.x: And Tats always remarked now that he knew just what it was after Lorenzo had gotten paralyzed, because something about his fingers, he cannot execute on his clandest like he had once did before. He said he knew what Lorenzo was saying when he said, well, that was it as far as playing like he used to, because he never could regain that form that he had. That was after the New York trip then? That was after the New York trip. That was in 25. Did he die up in New York though? He went back to New York. He stayed here…

I knew his wife, I think his wife just died two or three years ago. Just about, just about. That's right. That's why I thought he died there too. Yeah, he did die over there. Did he go back to play on that trip? Can you remember?
